name: Beryl Pimblott
story: Beryl Pimblott and David Pimblott founded Explorer Graphics Ltd in New Zealand in 1987. It was an early specialist GIS consultancy at a time when businesses and councils were beginning to obtain computer mapping services from commercial suppliers. NorthSouth GIS’s published company history names both founders; it does not assign Beryl a separate technical specialisation.

In 2005 the Pimblotts and Daniel Elroi established an international NorthSouth GIS collaboration. Explorer Graphics adopted the NorthSouth GIS NZ name in 2011, and the New Zealand company was acquired by AAM in 2014. These dates trace the business that Beryl co-founded without assuming that her individual role remained unchanged throughout those later reorganisations.
